## Interpretation

This table tests the meaningful cheap/expensive setup. A useful VoC setting requires a non-trivial oracle gap and a router that improves over always-cheap and always-full at positive compute cost. If the confidence router fails while oracle utility is high, the next step is a learned gain router using small-full uncertainty and action/state diagnostics.
